theme: Finding the hot spot from thermocouples at the edge
title: Edge Thermocouples: Backtracking the Hot Spot
strategies: fixed reference guess: all K sources at cell (1,1), onset 0, ignoring the boundary trace entirely

naive backward integration: literally reverse the diffusion stencil from the observed final boundary state, forcing the known trace at every backward step, with a mild ad hoc smoothing stabilizer; the reversal amplifies the highest spatial frequency by (1+4r) per step so it is only mildly wrong on low-r/short-T cases and diverges into noise on the higher-r/longer-T cases -- the trap

forward matched-pursuit search: precompute one stable forward simulation per candidate interior source position (impulse at onset 0), reuse it for every onset time via a time-shift (linearity of the equation), and greedily pick the (position, onset) that most reduces the residual sum of squared boundary-trace error, subtracting and repeating for all K sources -- never touches the unstable backward recursion
